relations.subject: Alfred Cooper Woolner
relations.evidence: Woolner was educated at Ipswich School and Trinity College, Oxford.

relations.subject: Alfred Cooper Woolner
relations.role: Registrar and Principal of its Oriental College
relations.evidence: In 1903, at the age of twenty-five Woolner he joined the University of the Punjab as its Registrar and Principal of its Oriental College.

relations.subject: Alfred Cooper Woolner
relations.evidence: He served as the vice-chancellor of the University of the Punjab, Lahore from 1928 to 1936.
